summary: LOOP0setup/LOOP1setup/LOOP0setupi/LOOP1setupi marked isNotDuplicable (ARM precedent: ARMInstrThumb2.td:5588-5712 at llvmorg-20.1.8, a6fd919cb3f5; TailDuplicator.cpp:623 refuses such blocks, MachineBlockPlacement tail-dup uses the same check at :808). These are the only hwloop instructions that exist before PULPFixupHwLoops (lp.starti/endi/counti and PseudoLOOPend are created by the fixup, which runs in addPreEmitPass2 after the outliner). The machine outliner ignores isNotDuplicable but already refuses the setups: they are terminators of blocks with successors and have an MBB operand (TargetInstrInfo::getOutliningType -> Illegal). BranchFolding tail merging does not copy instructions. No PULPFixupHwLoops.cpp / PULPHardwareLoops.cpp edits.
